2.w: The Beloved to Her Lover: Oh, how I wish you would kiss me passionately! For your lovemaking is more delightful than wine.

3.w: The fragrance of your colognes is delightful; your name is like the finest perfume. No wonder the young women adore you!

4.w: Draw me after you; let us hurry! May the king bring me into his bedroom chambers! The Maidens to the Lover: We will rejoice and delight in you; we will praise your love more than wine. The Beloved to Her Lover: How rightly the young women adore you!

5.w: The Beloved to the Maidens: I am dark but lovely, O maidens of Jerusalem, dark like the tents of Qedar, lovely like the tent curtains of Salmah.

6.w: Do not stare at me because I am dark, for the sun has burned my skin. My brothers were angry with me; they made me the keeper of the vineyards. Alas, my own vineyard I could not keep!

7.w: The Beloved to Her Lover: Tell me, O you whom my heart loves, where do you pasture your sheep? Where do you rest your sheep during the midday heat? Tell me lest I wander around beside the flocks of your companions! The Lover to His Beloved:

8.w: If you do not know, O most beautiful of women, simply follow the tracks of my flock, and pasture your little lambs beside the tents of the shepherds.

9.w: The Lover to His Beloved: O my beloved, you are like a mare among Pharaoh’s stallions.

10.w: Your cheeks are beautiful with ornaments; your neck is lovely with strings of jewels.

11.w: We will make for you gold ornaments studded with silver. The Beloved about Her Lover:

12.w: While the king was at his banqueting table, my nard gave forth its fragrance.

13.w: My beloved is like a fragrant pouch of myrrh spending the night between my breasts.

14.w: My beloved is like a cluster of henna blossoms in the vineyards of En Gedi.

15.w: The Lover to His Beloved: Oh, how beautiful you are, my beloved! Oh, how beautiful you are! Your eyes are like doves! The Beloved to Her Lover:

16.w: Oh, how handsome you are, my lover! Oh, how delightful you are! The lush foliage is our canopied bed;

17.w: the cedars are the beams of our bedroom chamber; the pines are the rafters of our bedroom.
